# Vaquero RV Park

> Long-term RV park in Pleasanton, Texas (Atascosa County), about 41 minutes south of downtown San Antonio. Monthly RV lots from $400/month, plus park-owned RVs and tiny homes for people without a rig. Monthly stays only: no nightly or weekly stays.

- Address: 772 Humble Camp Rd, Pleasanton, TX 78064
- Phone (call or text): (830) 480-2590
- Website: https://vaquerorvpark.com/
- How to rent: send the inquiry form at https://vaquerorvpark.com/#contact, or call or text. Approved residents pay rent through the resident portal.
- Facts current as of 2026-11-13. Rent and open lots change; the website is the source of truth.

## Rent by rental type
- RV lot · 30 amp: $400/month. Bring your own RV or travel trailer. 30-amp electrical service.
- RV lot · 50 amp: $500/month. For larger rigs and fifth wheels that need 50-amp service.
- Park-owned RV: from $700/month. No rig? Move straight into an RV we own, already set up on its lot. Rent depends on the unit.
- Park-owned tiny home: from $875/month. Efficiency tiny homes on a 50-amp lot. Rent depends on the unit.
- Rent-to-own: ask us. Rent-to-own homes on select lots. Ask us what's coming available.

## Open now
- Lot 10: $725/month, $550 deposit. Park-owned, furnished 1 bed / 1 bath RV, ready for move-in. Utilities, free Wi-Fi and laundry access included. Month-to-month.
- Lot 21: $800/month, $550 deposit. Park-owned 2 bed / 1 bath RV, furnished and ready for move-in. Utilities, free Wi-Fi and laundry access included. Month-to-month.

## Amenities
- Free Wi-Fi: Park-wide outdoor access points. Stream, work, video-call.
- 24-hr surveillance: Camera coverage around the clock across the property.
- Pets welcome: Cats and small dogs are part of the neighborhood here.
- Security gates (coming soon): Controlled entry for residents and their guests.
- Dog park (coming soon): A fenced off-leash area, built with Phase 2.
- Kids play area (coming soon): A central playground, built with Phase 2.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you offer nightly or weekly stays?
  A: No. Vaquero is a monthly, long-term community. Our leases are built for people who live here.
- Q: What rental types are available?
  A: RV lots with 30-amp or 50-amp service, park-owned RVs, park-owned tiny homes, and a few rent-to-own homes.
- Q: How much is rent?
  A: RV lots are $400 per month (30-amp) or $500 per month (50-amp). Park-owned RVs and tiny homes cost more and vary by unit. Each open lot lists its own rent and deposit.
- Q: Are pets allowed?
  A: Yes, cats and small dogs are welcome. A fenced dog park is coming with our Phase 2 expansion.
- Q: How do I apply?
  A: Send us the inquiry form or call or text us. We'll follow up about the lot you want. Approved residents pay rent and send maintenance requests through the resident portal.
- Q: Is there internet?
  A: Yes. Free Wi-Fi covers the park, and 24-hour camera surveillance is active.
- Q: Where is Vaquero RV Park?
  A: 772 Humble Camp Rd, Pleasanton, Texas 78064, in Atascosa County. Call or text (830) 480-2590 to set up a showing.
